title: Agent memory: what does Copilot remember about a user, and who can switch it off?
summary: The documented memory controls, licensing and deletion behavior are supported. Minor corrections should acknowledge conflicting deletion limits in Microsoft's documentation, name the purge request properties and cite the additional references supporting the page.

claims.where: What it is; summary
claims.claim: Memory carries context about a person into later conversations so the person need not repeat it.
claims.quote: Memory lets an agent carry what it learns into later conversations, such as a person's role, preferences, and corrections. People don't need to repeat themselves

claims.claim: Administrators need take no action to turn Copilot memory on, only to disable it if desired.
claims.quote: No action is required to turn on Copilot memory; you only need to turn off Copilot memory for end-users or the tenant if desired.
